description: {{PROJECT_NAME}} operating-system hooks manifest. Source code is in 能力资产/tools/hooks; execution scripts are in 能力资产/tools/scripts.

hooks.description: Check consistency of README/INDEX anchors for ADRs, PROPs, the meta-rule pool, hooks documentation, and PM workspace entry points.
Check the ADR README against ADR-*.md files; Check reports differences only, while Apply updates the table.
Check whether the PM transition history in 状态.md has gone more than 30 minutes without an update; exit 10 is a strong, nonblocking reminder.

Check pending handoff backlog, heading order ①-⑥ in pending cards, the 5 states of ⑤ Status, archival age from accepted filenames, and broken pending-handoff links in 状态.md; report warnings only, without automatically moving historical cards.

Check that chat output contains ①-⑦ in order, PM transition history, a ⑥ details path under 交接区/待接手/, and PM history line numbers in 状态.md. After acceptance and archival, when no pending cards remain, ⑥ may point to the accepted card. Supply TextPath when connecting an external chat-output event.
Check whether {{APP_REPO_DIR}}/.git/hooks/pre-commit and pre-push are connected to the project wrappers.
Run the current overall operating-system health check.
Pre-release gate: require npm test (vitest run) and npm run build to pass before push; any failure returns exit 1 and blocks push.
Knowledge-retention cadence reminder: after at least N framework activity batches since the last RETRO, remind Project PM to assign Knowledge PM to write a RETRO (issue CK / Layer 4).
